ui.settings_were_changed_from_the_tray_o: Settings were changed from the tray or another dashboard. Review the saved version before continuing. Reloading discards unsaved changes on this screen.
ui.original_audio_passes_through_the_con: Select the Babel devices in your apps. With translation off, original audio passes through your chosen physical devices, including when no session is running.
ui.your_physical_microphone_passes_throu: Your physical microphone passes through AI translation to the virtual microphone
ui.e_g_use_natural_language_and_preserve: e.g. Use natural language and preserve technical terms.
ui.available_with_conversation_models_co: Available with conversation models. Continuous mode uses its own translation instructions.
ui.audio_sent_to_the_virtual_output_pass: Audio sent to the virtual output passes through AI translation to your headphones
ui.e_g_preserve_proper_names_and_use_an_: e.g. Preserve proper names and use an informal tone.
ui.each_route_can_use_a_different_transl: Each route can use a different translator and voice.
ui.paste_a_key_to_use_in_this_app_instan: Paste a key to use in this app instance
ui.the_key_stays_in_memory_until_babel_e: The key stays in memory until Babel exits. The environment variable remains available as a fallback.
ui.for_local_translation_start_whisper_o: Built-in mode starts Whisper, Qwen and Piper automatically. Models download on first selection; subsequent runs use the cache. External servers are optional. Transcription has its own recognizer in the Transcription page.
ui.gemini_live_translate_attempts_to_pre: Gemini Live Translate attempts to preserve original voice characteristics, without a guarantee. OpenAI Translate uses the model's native voice and does not promise to preserve vocal identity. Neither route identifies participants in mixed audio.
ui.for_a_fixed_voice_create_or_select_a_: For a fixed voice, create or select a library voice and choose re-synthesis for the route. This adds processing and latency. Cloning requires an explicitly uploaded reference recording; it is not performed automatically on call participants.
ui.smaller_queues_reduce_accumulated_aud: Smaller queues reduce accumulated audio. If playback underruns occur, increase the queue or device latency. The network and model also affect delay.
files.shared_location: A shared base folder and filename pattern for your session.
files.base_hint: Choose an absolute folder path on the computer running Babel. The destination stays the same wherever Babel is launched. ~ and environment variables are not expanded.
files.base_absolute_unix: Enter an absolute base folder starting with /; relative paths, . and ~ are not accepted.
files.base_absolute_unknown: Enter an absolute base folder on the Babel host. Relative paths, . and ~ are not accepted.
files.base_absolute_windows: Enter an absolute base folder with a drive and root, such as C:\Babel, or a complete UNC path such as \\server\share. Relative and drive-relative paths are not accepted.
files.base_host_unavailable: Babel’s operating system is unavailable. Refresh the device list to verify the base folder format.
files.destination_hint: Relative to the base folder, or use an absolute path for a separate location on the Babel host.
files.next_sessions: Folder previews do not save settings or create directories. Save your changes to apply them to the next sessions.
files.preview_idle: Waiting for the host to resolve the folders.
files.preview_loading: Resolving folders on the Babel host…
files.preview_invalid: Enter a valid absolute base folder to preview the destinations.
files.preview_unavailable: The folder preview is paused until Babel’s operating system is available. Saved settings can still be used.
files.preview_ready: Full paths on the computer running Babel, including destinations that are currently disabled.
files.preview_unsupported: This Babel version does not provide folder previews. Update Babel to verify the full destinations.
files.preview_error: The folder preview could not be loaded.
files.preview_error_detail: Check the folders or the connection to Babel: {error}
files.preview_invalid_response: Babel returned an incomplete folder preview.
files.preview_timeout: Babel took too long to resolve the folders.
ui.a_shared_name_for_the_transcript_and_: A shared name for the transcript and recording.
ui.uses_the_session_name_adapted_for_a_f: uses the session name adapted for a filename;
ui.is_the_required_unique_identifier_use: is the required unique identifier. Use only these placeholders, without directory separators. The .txt and .wav extensions are added automatically.
ui.keep_what_was_said_in_the_speaker_s_l: Keep what was said, in the speaker's language.
ui.a_folder_on_the_machine_running_babel: A folder on the machine running Babel, not the browser's downloads folder.
ui.what_you_say_into_the_physical_microp: What you say into the physical microphone.
ui.the_audio_the_app_sends_to_the_virtua: The audio the app sends to the virtual output.
ui.preserves_timestamps_or_alignments_su: Preserves timestamps or alignments supplied by the model; otherwise uses receipt time. Word-level timestamps are not guaranteed.
ui.works_with_translation_on_or_off_each: Works with translation on or off. Each session saves one .txt file with the selected sources in their original language, identifying the source of each segment. Translated text is not saved. Requires transcription support in the selected model.
ui.save_the_selected_routes_together_in_: Save the selected routes together in one WAV file.
ui.a_folder_on_the_machine_running_babel: A folder on the machine running Babel. It can differ from the transcripts folder.
ui.both_sources_are_mixed_into_one_file_: Both sources are mixed into one file per session. Translated audio is not recorded. Works with translation on or off, independently of transcription.
ui.open_babel_in_the_tray_when_you_log_i: Open Babel in the tray when you log in. Original audio passes through the configured devices; translation, transcription and recording wait for a session to start.
ui.start_in_the_tray_at_login: Start in the tray at login
ui.as_the_output_in_your_calling_app_bab: as the output in your calling app. Babel uses the physical devices selected in Routing.
ui.on_linux_create_the_devices_here_maco: . On Linux, create the devices here. On macOS and Windows, install the Babel native driver package explicitly, then select its corresponding endpoints in Babel and your calling app.
ui.local_control_processing_by_the_selec: Local control · processing by the selected provider
ui.preset_designed_and_cloned_voices_in_: Preset, designed and cloned voices in your account.
ui.load_the_library_to_see_the_voices_av: Load the library to see the voices available in this account.
ui.describe_timbre_apparent_age_range_ac: Describe timbre, apparent age range, accent and speaking style.
ui.required_by_gemini_follow_the_wording: Required by Gemini. Follow the wording and format specified in the provider's documentation.
ui.could_not_verify_the_settings_revisio: Could not verify the settings revision. Update Babel and reload the dashboard.
ui.settings_updated_from_the_tray_or_ano: Settings updated from the tray or another dashboard.
ui.these_settings_use_an_old_format_rest: These settings use an old format. Restart the updated Babel to load provider profiles.
ui.this_continuous_model_does_not_accept: This continuous model does not accept prompts. Saving in this mode clears this route's instructions.
ui.translation_instructions_are_not_used: Translation instructions are not used while this translation is off.
ui.add_tone_terminology_and_proper_names: Add tone, terminology and proper names to guide translation.
ui.original_audio_if_transcription_is_en: Original audio passes through. Configure independent speech recognition in Transcription.
ui.transcription_translation_and_voice_t: Transcription, translation and voice through local services, in segments.
ui.continuous_translation_with_automatic: Continuous translation with automatic source language detection.
ui.conversation_model_usually_waits_for_: Conversation model: usually waits for pauses before responding.
ui.this_route_transmits_the_original_voi: This route transmits the original voice. Synthesis options are only used with translation on.
ui.gemini_live_translate_attempts_to_pre: Gemini Live Translate attempts to preserve original voice characteristics, without a guarantee or speaker identification.
ui.openai_translate_uses_the_model_s_nat: OpenAI Translate uses the model's native voice. Vocal identity preservation is not guaranteed; a custom voice requires re-synthesis.
ui.uses_the_piper_service_enter_a_voice_: Uses Piper. In built-in mode, the automatic voice follows the target language; a supported voice ID overrides it.
ui.uses_the_translator_s_own_audio_outpu: Uses the translator's own audio output and the profile's default voice when no other voice is selected.
ui.re_synthesizes_translated_text_with_t: Re-synthesizes translated text with this fixed voice. Adds latency; translated text is used internally and is not saved in original transcripts.
ui.gemini_live_translate_continuous_tran: Gemini Live Translate: continuous translation without prompts or a fixed native voice. Conversational Gemini Live: instructions and preset voices. Library voices require Gemini TTS on the route. Fixed official endpoint. Configure original speech recognition separately in Transcription.
ui.gpt_realtime_translate_continuous_tra: gpt-realtime-translate: continuous translation. gpt-realtime-2.1: conversation with instructions and preset voices. Leave the endpoint empty for automatic selection. Custom endpoints must be API-compatible. Configure original speech recognition separately in Transcription.
ui.additional_voice_synthesis_using_elev: Additional voice synthesis using ElevenLabs library IDs. Configure the route with another translation provider and choose ElevenLabs under Output voice. Fixed official endpoint.
ui.conversation_10_ms_packets_and_200_ms: Conversation: 10 ms packets and 200 ms silence.
ui.conversation_20_ms_packets_and_400_ms: Conversation: 20 ms packets and 400 ms silence.
ui.conversation_40_ms_packets_and_700_ms: Conversation: 40 ms packets and 700 ms silence.
ui.reopen_the_full_address_shown_in_the_: Reopen the full address shown in the terminal to connect this dashboard.
ui.settings_changed_outside_this_dashboa: Settings changed outside this dashboard. Reload saved settings before saving or starting.
ui.session_active_end_it_to_change_setti: Session active. End it to change settings; physical devices can be switched from the tray.
ui.original_audio_routing_works_without_: Original audio routing works without a session. Enable translation, transcription or recording to start a session.
ui.you_have_unsaved_settings_starting_th: You have unsaved settings. Starting the session also saves them.
ui.choose_which_features_to_use_and_star: Choose which features to use and start a session to translate, transcribe or record.
ui.babel_took_too_long_to_respond_check_: Babel took too long to respond. Check the terminal and try again.
ui.session_started_with_the_selected_fea: Session started with the selected features. Original audio continues on routes without translation.
ui.session_ended_original_audio_passes_t: Session ended. Original audio passes through the configured devices again.
ui.saved_settings_reloaded_review_device: Saved settings reloaded. Review devices before starting.
ui.autostart_enabled_babel_opens_with_lo: Autostart enabled. Babel opens with local original audio routing, without starting a session.
ui.autostart_enabled_babel_will_open_in_: Autostart enabled. Babel will open in the tray with original audio, without starting translation, transcription or recording.
ui.a_key_is_available_for_this_profile_i: A key is available for this profile, in memory or the environment. Its value is not displayed or saved in settings.
ui.no_key_is_available_apply_a_temporary: No key is available. Apply a temporary key or set the environment variable before starting Babel.
ui.enter_a_key_for_this_app_instance: Enter a key for this app instance.
ui.key_applied_to_this_app_instance_s_me: Key applied to this app instance's memory only. It will be discarded when Babel exits.
ui.temporary_key_removed_a_key_set_in_th: Temporary key removed. A key set in the environment remains available as a fallback.
ui.no_voices_loaded_use_load_voices_or_c: No voices loaded. Use “Load voices” or create a voice in this account.
ui.complete_verification_of_this_voice_i: Complete verification of this voice in the provider's account before using it.
ui.the_provider_took_too_long_to_respond: The provider took too long to respond. Reload the library to check whether the voice was created before trying again.
ui.to_connect_securely_open_the_full_bab: To connect securely, open the full “Babel dashboard” link shown in the terminal. The address includes a session key after #token=.
interface.using: Using {language}. This only changes the interface.
interface.unavailable: Could not load the interface language: {error}
audio.quality_hint: {description} Continuous models and local services use their own audio segmentation. Model fidelity does not change.
routing.waiting_microphone: waiting for the virtual microphone to be the system default or used by an app
routing.waiting_speaker: waiting for an app to play audio through the virtual output
error.connection: {error} Check whether Babel is still running in the terminal.
voice.library_hint: Uses the {provider} profile key. Loaded voices can be applied as additional synthesis to either route. Access depends on the account and model.
voice.clone_disclosure: This action sends the reference recording to {provider} to create a voice in your account. Choose a recording you have permission to use.
voice.clone_consent_disclosure: This action sends the reference and consent recordings to {provider} to create a voice in your account. Choose a recording you have permission to use.
voice.design_disclosure: This action sends the name, description and language to {provider} to create a voice in your account.
voice.selected_microphone: Voice “{name}” selected for the microphone. Save settings to apply.
voice.selected_speaker: Voice “{name}” selected for the output. Save settings to apply.

agent.title: Voice commands
agent.intro: Say the wake name and a command. Your local agent chooses a tool from your integrations.
agent.independent: Listens only to your original physical microphone when Babel is the system’s default microphone or an app uses it, even without a session. Choosing a physical microphone as the system default pauses listening unless an app still uses Babel. Speaker audio never activates commands. Translation, recording and transcription remain independent.
agent.conflict: Agent settings changed in another dashboard. Reload the saved settings before saving your edits.
agent.local_hint: Whisper recognizes speech locally while microphone routing is active. Needle3 loads only for a command. Babel releases idle managed models after the configured interval; disabling commands stops managed services. External servers keep their own lifecycle.
agent.revision_missing: Could not verify the agent settings revision. Reload the dashboard.
agent.credentials_hint: Save the key references in agent settings first. Values entered here stay in process memory and are never saved in the configuration file. For persistence, set the referenced environment variable before starting Babel.
agent.credential_missing: Choose a saved key reference and enter its value.
agent.credential_applied: Temporary secret applied. It will be cleared when Babel exits.
agent.credential_cleared: Temporary secret removed. An environment variable may still provide this credential.
agent.no_references: No saved credential references. Configure and save a reference above if your service requires authentication.
agent.credential_absent: No credential found for this reference.
agent.request_timeout: The service took too long to respond. Check the local service and try again.
agent.phase_inactive: Select Babel as your system microphone
agent.listening_hint: Say the wake name followed by your command.
agent.activated_hint: Speak your command. A short pause finishes it.
agent.transcribing_hint: Recognizing the original microphone audio locally.
agent.deciding_hint: Needle3 is choosing a tool from your enabled integrations.
agent.executing_hint: Waiting for the selected integration to respond.
agent.service_setup_hint: Check the installed services and their folder for auto mode, or check the addresses of manually managed services. Audio routing and session controls remain available.
agent.saved: Agent settings saved. Audio routing and session settings were preserved.
mcp.title: MCP integrations
mcp.intro: Choose which services the agent can use for spoken commands.
mcp.invalid_map: Use one NAME=value pair per line in “{field}”.
mcp.empty: No integrations yet. Add an MCP server so the agent can discover its tools.
mcp.enabled: Allow voice commands to use this integration
mcp.name: Integration name
mcp.allow_hint: Leave empty to allow all tools advertised by this integration.
mcp.public_hint: Public values only. Put passwords and tokens in secret references instead.
mcp.secret_hint: Use environment variable names, not secret values. Example: API_KEY=SERVICE_API_KEY.
mcp.reference_hint: Environment variable name. Apply its value in Integration credentials below.
mcp.invalid_auth_url: The server returned an invalid authorization URL.
mcp.authorize_hint: Open the authorization page to sign in, then return to this dashboard.
platform.autostart_pending: Startup availability depends on Babel’s operating system.
platform.autostart_unavailable: Automatic startup is unavailable until a supported operating system is detected.
platform.setup_pending: Select two independent virtual audio paths and the physical devices Babel should use.
platform.native_mapping: Babel driver installation and device mapping
platform.native_mapping_hint: The Babel driver provides two independent paths: one for your microphone and one for received audio.
platform.mapping_mic_playback: Babel: send to the virtual microphone
platform.native_install_manual: Build or obtain the Babel driver package for your system and install it explicitly with the required authorization. This panel does not execute or elevate installers. Then refresh the device list and select both routes.
platform.macos_license: Optional BlackHole drivers are GPL-3.0 software with separate integration terms. Babel does not bundle them; its own driver does not require them.
platform.windows_license: Optional VB-CABLE A+B is Donationware For Download. Obtain its download and license from VB-Audio; Babel’s own driver does not require this package.
platform.macos_activity: Automatic routing requires macOS 14.2 or later. The microphone activates when Babel is the system default or an external app uses it; the output needs an app sending audio to Babel. If activity cannot be verified, the affected route stays closed and shows a diagnostic.
platform.windows_activity: Automatic routing recognizes the two Babel Audio v1 pairs and supported VB-CABLE pairs. Missing or ambiguous endpoints or unavailable WASAPI session data keep the affected route closed with a diagnostic. Exclusive mode, ASIO and Kernel Streaming have not been validated.
platform.linux_setup: Choose Babel_Microphone as the system’s default microphone or use it in your calling app. Select Babel_Speaker as the app’s output. Babel routes them to the physical devices selected in Routing.
platform.linux_details: Create the virtual devices here using PulseAudio or PipeWire with PulseAudio compatibility. In Babel, use Babel_Microphone_Bus for microphone playback and the monitor of Babel_Speaker for output capture.
platform.linux_permissions: Run Babel in your user session. The pactl, parec and pacat tools and a running audio server are required. The tray needs StatusNotifier/AppIndicator support.
platform.linux_autostart: Linux uses the packaged systemd user service when available, with XDG desktop autostart as a fallback. The selected method is shown below.
platform.macos_setup: Install the Babel native driver package. Choose Babel Microphone as the system’s default microphone or use it in your calling app. Select Babel Speaker as the app’s output.
platform.macos_details: In Babel, send microphone audio to the output side of Babel Microphone and capture received audio from the input side of Babel Speaker. Keep your physical microphone and headphones selected in Routing. Source and build scripts are included; signed packages and validation on macOS hardware are still pending.
platform.macos_permissions: Allow microphone access for the app or terminal running Babel in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone. Refresh the device list after installing the drivers.
platform.macos_autostart: macOS starts Babel through a LaunchAgent for this user. Review the permission to run in the background in the system’s login-item settings.
platform.windows_setup: Install the Babel native driver package. Choose Babel Microphone as the system’s default microphone or use it in your calling app. Select Babel Speaker as the app’s output.
platform.windows_details: In Babel, send microphone audio to Babel Microphone Feed and capture received audio from Babel Speaker Monitor. Keep your physical microphone and headphones selected in Routing. Source and build scripts are included; signed packages and validation on Windows hardware are still pending.
platform.windows_permissions: Allow microphone access for desktop apps in Windows privacy settings. Do not enable “Listen to this device” on the virtual cables; Babel handles the routing.
platform.windows_autostart: Windows starts Babel through the current user’s Run registry entry. Review it in the system’s Startup apps settings.
platform.unknown_setup: Choose the physical devices and two independent virtual audio paths. The dashboard will show specific instructions after detecting the system running Babel.
platform.unknown_details: Device creation and removal are unavailable on this dashboard until the host platform is confirmed. Refresh the device list to check again.
platform.unknown_permissions: Device names and permissions depend on the computer running Babel, not on this browser.
platform.read_error: Could not read Babel’s operating system: {error}
platform.invalid_metadata: The host returned invalid operating-system information.
platform.management_unavailable: Virtual device creation and removal are not available on this host.
workspace.audio_description: Control what you say and what you hear.
workspace.voices_description: Choose providers and how your translated voice sounds.
workspace.files_description: Record original audio and keep one conversation transcript.
workspace.commands_description: Use your microphone to control connected tools.
workspace.settings_description: Manage storage, system settings and startup on this computer.
workspace.audio_tuning_description: Adjust the balance between latency and audio quality.
workspace.routing_description: Choose the real and virtual devices for each direction.
workspace.translation_description: Set languages, providers and voices for what you say and hear.
workspace.transcription_description: Recognize the original words with a separate provider and language for each source.
workspace.recording_description: Save the original audio from both sides in one recording.
workspace.translation_intro: Enable translation separately for each direction. With translation off, audio routing continues with the original sound.
workspace.routing_intro: Choose the physical devices Babel should use. Microphone routing starts when Babel is the system’s default microphone or an app uses it. Received audio routes only while an app sends audio to Babel. No session is needed.
workspace.shared_files_hint: The base folder and filename pattern apply to transcripts and recordings.
workspace.recognition_hint: Configure a recognizer, language and credentials here for each original source, independently from translation.
agent.services_directory_hint: Use an absolute folder containing .tools and scripts. Leave empty to use the folder containing the TOML configuration. Install Whisper, its model and the Needle environment there before using auto mode.
agent.endpoint_hint: Use auto to let Babel manage this service on a system-assigned port, or enter the URL of an independently managed local service.
agent.whisper_key_hint: For an independently managed authenticated Whisper server only. Leave empty with auto.
platform.macos_driver_status: The Babel AudioServerPlugIn source and build scripts are included. A signed release package and validation on macOS hardware are still pending.
platform.windows_driver_status: The Babel WaveRT driver source and build scripts are included. A signed release package and validation on Windows hardware are still pending.
platform.macos_external: BlackHole 2ch and 16ch remain optional, separately installed alternatives. They are not required by the Babel driver.
platform.windows_external: Two independent VB-CABLE, CABLE-A/B/C/D pairs remain optional, separately installed alternatives. They are not required by the Babel driver.
platform.native_driver_guide: Babel native driver packages and builds
platform.native_routing_guide: Routing and permissions for this system
autostart.method_registry_run: Startup method: user Run registry entry.
stt.providers_description: Models, connections and credentials for original speech recognition.
stt.independent_hint: Choose a recognizer and original language for each source. These settings are independent from translation and voices. Use auto to detect the language.
stt.gemini_hint: Gemini Live Transcribe saves original words. This profile is separate from Gemini translation and voice settings; the connection uses the official endpoint.
stt.openai_hint: Recognizes original speech without translation or voice synthesis. An empty endpoint uses the provider default.
stt.deepgram_hint: Use auto for the multilingual mode supported by the selected model. Speaker labels and speech timestamps are saved when supplied by Deepgram; labels identify speakers within that connection, not real-world identities.
stt.whisper_hint: Built-in Whisper uses multilingual models. Compact Base is the default balance; Tiny uses less CPU with a greater risk of recognition errors; Small may improve recognition at higher cost. Sizes are model downloads, not RAM. External mode uses your server’s model. Timing and transcription remain independent from translation.
stt.credentials_hint: Keys stay in memory for this app instance. Profiles using the same credential name share that key.
stt.optional_credential: No credential name is set. Use a key only if this whisper.cpp server requires authentication.
stt.credential_name_required: Enter the API key environment variable name for this profile before applying a key.
stt.silence_shorter: Silence must be shorter than the segment duration.
local.settings_intro: Babel downloads selected models when you save, loads them for a session and releases them after inactivity.
local.directory_hint: Leave empty to use this account’s application cache, or enter an absolute path. Existing models are not moved.
local.threads_hint: Applies to recognition and text translation. New setups use up to 2 threads to leave CPU available for live audio. Piper manages its own threads.
local.download_hint: The first preparation needs internet and disk space. Once the selected models are cached, inference works offline.
local.idle_hint: Select a built-in local provider and save settings to prepare it.
local.preparing_hint: Babel is downloading or loading the selected models. Original audio routing remains available.
local.ready_hint: The selected local engines are running. No separate server needs to be started.
local.error_hint: Check the preparation details, then save settings again to retry.
local.managed_credentials: The built-in recognizer does not require an API key.
local.preparing_session: Preparing local models. Starting a session waits until preparation finishes.
local.start_cancelled: Session start cancelled. Model files already downloaded remain available.
history.settings_intro: Keep a rolling window of original audio while Babel is routing.
history.retention_hint: Default: 10 minutes. From 1 second to 60 minutes, in whole seconds. Older audio is replaced automatically; disabling history clears it when you save.
history.privacy: History stays in memory. It is only written to recording files or sent for transcription when you explicitly include it at session start. Closing Babel clears it.
history.start_privacy: Before you start, this history is neither written to files nor sent for transcription.
history.scope: Applies only to the sources selected for recording and transcription. Translation and playback start with live audio. This choice resets after every session start.
history.disabled_hint: Enable and save history retention in Settings to keep recent audio.
history.features_hint: Enable recording or transcription to include recent history.
history.empty_hint: No history is available for the selected sources yet. Microphone history needs Babel as the system microphone or in use by an app. Received-audio history needs an app sending audio to Babel.
history.partial_hint: If less audio is available than requested, only the available portion is included.
history.retention_invalid: Enter a duration from 1 second to 60 minutes, in whole seconds.
history.request_invalid: Enter a duration of at least 1 second and at most {minutes} minutes, in whole seconds.
history.unavailable_error: Recent history is unavailable for the selected recording or transcription sources. Wait for audio, update your selections, or uncheck Include recent history.
history.transcribing: Transcribing {duration} of recent history. Live audio continues.
local.idle_unload_hint: Default: 60 seconds after the session releases the engines. Weights stay on disk; the next session reloads them. External servers are managed separately.
local.cached_hint: Selected model files are ready. Engines load when a session needs them and release memory after inactivity.
agent.local_threads_hint: Applies to managed Whisper. Default: up to 2 threads. Needle manages its own processing threads.
agent.idle_unload_secs_hint: Default: 60 seconds. Whisper is released after microphone routing stops. Needle releases its model after the last command, while its lightweight service stays available.
agent.whisper_model_hint: Managed Whisper only. The model must be installed in the local services folder. Existing Base installations remain usable until compact Base is installed.
